mintAuthority.summary: COPm is minted via the Mento Broker (0x777A...) which is the sole authorized minter (broker() getter confirmed). The Broker's proxy admin and the COPm token owner and proxy admin all resolve to the Mento Timelock (0x890DB...) with a 2-day delay.

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for COPm
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, broker() on COPm (0x8a567e2ae79ca692bd748ab832081c45de4041ea) returned 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD (Mento BrokerProxy). The Broker's EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147 (Mento Timelock).

controls.label: Mento Timelock — COPm token owner and proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, owner() on COPm returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned the same address. getMinDelay() on the Timelock returned 0x2a300 = 172800 seconds (48 hours).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69287341: owner() = Timelock 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147 (confirmed); EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = same Timelock; getMinDelay() = 172800s (48h); broker() = 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD (Mento BrokerProxy, confirmed as sole authorized minter); Broker EIP-1967 proxy admin = same Timelock. Celo Registry confirms Broker = 0x777A... All mint-capable surfaces resolved. Economically, Broker issuance is the collateral-exchange path; changing that path or authorizing different mint logic requires the independently enforced 48-hour Mento Timelock, so the encoding-derived unbounded cap is superseded by raiseable semantics. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the two-day governance timelock bounds mint-path changes, the COPm-scoped live adapter covers the full upstream reserve mix continuously, and no named prudential regulator or independent attestor applies.
